plain: The Tic Tac is a white oval object, shaped like the mint, that US Navy pilots say they saw in the sky. A young researcher named Deep Prasad tells podcast host Jesse Michels that it poses a problem for the scientific method laid out by the old English thinker Francis Bacon, which relies on repeating experiments. He says the Tic Tac showed up once and cannot be made to happen again, yet it clearly needs to be studied, an idea he links to a written work called The Evolution of Science and the Interactive Universe.
